<div id="indicator-section-grid" class="home-pills indicator-section-grid"></div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async () => {
  const sectionList = document.querySelector("#indicator-section-grid");
  const sidebar = document.querySelector("#quarto-sidebar .sidebar-menu-container > ul");
  if (!sectionList || !sidebar) return;

  const response = await fetch("all-indicators.html");
  if (!response.ok) return;

  const sourceDocument = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await response.text(), "text/html");
  const sourceUrl = new URL("all-indicators.html", window.location.href);
  const sectionItems = Array.from(sourceDocument.querySelectorAll("#quarto-sidebar .sidebar-item-section"));

  sectionItems.forEach((section) => {
    const title = section.querySelector(".sidebar-item-container .menu-text")?.textContent.trim();
    if (!title) return;

    const accordion = document.createElement("details");
    accordion.className = "indicator-section";
    accordion.name = "indicator-sections";

    const summary = document.createElement("summary");
    summary.className = "indicator-section-summary";
    const summaryContent = document.createElement("span");
    summaryContent.className = "indicator-section-summary-content";

    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.className = "indicator-section-title";
    label.textContent = title;

    const placeholder = document.createElement("span");
    placeholder.className = "indicator-section-placeholder";
    placeholder.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    placeholder.textContent = "Icon";

    summaryContent.append(label, placeholder);
    summary.append(summaryContent);

    const cards = document.createElement("div");
    cards.className = "indicator-card-grid";

    section.querySelectorAll(".sidebar-section a.sidebar-link").forEach((item) => {
      const cardLink = document.createElement("a");
      cardLink.className = "quarto-grid-link";
      cardLink.href = new URL(item.getAttribute("href"), sourceUrl).href;

      const card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = "quarto-grid-item card h-100";
      const body = document.createElement("div");
      body.className = "card-body post-contents";

      const cardTitle = document.createElement("h5");
      cardTitle.className = "card-title listing-title";
      cardTitle.textContent = item.querySelector(".menu-text")?.textContent.trim() || "";

      const description = document.createElement("p");
      description.className = "card-text listing-description";

      body.append(cardTitle, description);
      card.append(body);
      cardLink.append(card);
      cards.append(cardLink);
    });

    accordion.append(summary, cards);
    sectionList.append(accordion);
  });

  const listingDocument = sourceDocument;
  const listingUrl = new URL("all-indicators.html", window.location.href);
  const listingCards = new Map();

  listingDocument.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-container-grid a.quarto-grid-link").forEach((item) => {
    const path = new URL(item.getAttribute("href"), listingUrl).pathname;
    listingCards.set(path, {
      title: item.querySelector(".listing-title")?.textContent.trim(),
      description: item.querySelector(".listing-description")?.textContent.trim()
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll(".indicator-card-grid a.quarto-grid-link").forEach((item) => {
    const card = listingCards.get(new URL(item.getAttribute("href"), window.location.href).pathname);
    if (!card) return;

    const title = item.querySelector(".listing-title");
    const description = item.querySelector(".listing-description");
    if (card.title) title.textContent = card.title;
    if (card.description) description.textContent = card.description;
  });

  const categories = sourceDocument.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category");
  if (!categories) return;

  const categoryList = categories.cloneNode(true);
  categoryList.querySelectorAll(".category").forEach((category) => {
    const name = decodeURIComponent(atob(category.dataset.category));
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.className = "category";
    link.innerHTML = category.innerHTML;
    link.href = name
      ? `all-indicators.html#category=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`
      : "all-indicators.html";
    category.replaceWith(link);
  });

  const categoryItem = document.createElement("li");
  categoryItem.className = "sidebar-item";
  categoryItem.append(categoryList);
  sidebar.querySelectorAll(":scope > .sidebar-item-section").forEach((section) => {
    section.remove();
  });
  sidebar.append(categoryItem);

});
</script>
